steps.title: Understand the need
steps.text: I start from the requirement: who uses it, what data it handles and what must not break, so the scope is clear before any code.

steps.title: Design the APIs
steps.text: I define API contracts and PostgreSQL data models first, so frontend, QA and other services can build against a stable interface.

steps.title: Build and test
steps.text: I build in TypeScript or Python, write unit tests for the endpoints and review changes with the team before they ship.

steps.title: Deploy and support
steps.text: I ship through dev, UAT and production, then stay on for post-release fixes and monitoring.
